[id="configuring-model-cache-node-groups_{context}"]
= Configure model cache node groups

[role="_abstract"]
You can configure node groups to define which nodes in your cluster participate in model caching and how local storage is allocated.
Each node group creates an agent DaemonSet that manages model files on the target nodes.
Node groups are required for local disk caching but are not required for network volume caching.

.Prerequisites

* You have cluster administrator privileges for your {openshift-platform} cluster.
* You have enabled model cache on the cluster.
For more information, see xref:enabling-model-cache_{context}[Enable model cache].
* You have GPU nodes with local storage available, such as NVMe drives.
* You know the local storage path on each target node where you plan to store models.
* You have labeled the target nodes appropriately, for example, by GPU type.

.Procedure

. Identify the target GPU nodes and note their node labels and local storage paths.
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get nodes -l nvidia.com/gpu.present=true -o wide
----

. Create a `LocalModelNodeGroup` resource that defines the storage configuration and node targeting:
+
[source,yaml]
----
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1alpha1
kind: LocalModelNodeGroup
metadata:
  name: <node_group_name> <1>
spec:
  storageLimit: "<storage_limit>" <2>
  persistentVolumeSpec:
    accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
    capacity:
      storage: "<pv_capacity>" <3>
    local:
      path: "<local_storage_path>" <4>
    nodeAffinity:
      required:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
          - matchExpressions:
              - key: "<node_label_key>" <5>
                operator: In
                values:
                  - "<node_label_value>" <6>
    storageClassName: ""
    persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  persistentVolumeClaimSpec:
    accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
    resources:
      requests:
        storage: "<pvc_size>" <7>
    storageClassName: ""
----
+
--
Where:

`<node_group_name>`:: Specifies a unique name for the node group, such as `gpu-nodes`.
`<storage_limit>`:: Specifies the maximum total storage for cached models per node, such as `500Gi`.
This limit prevents cached models from consuming all available disk space.
`<pv_capacity>`:: Specifies the capacity of the persistent volume on each node.
This value must be large enough to hold the models you plan to cache.
`<local_storage_path>`:: Specifies the path to local storage on each node, such as `/mnt/models`.
This path must match the directory where you set ownership permissions when enabling model cache.
`<node_label_key>`:: Specifies the label key used to select target nodes, such as `nvidia.com/gpu.present`.
`<node_label_value>`:: Specifies the label value for the node selector, such as `true`.
`<pvc_size>`:: Specifies the requested storage size for the persistent volume claim.
--

. Apply the resource:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc apply -f <node_group_file>.yaml
----
+
[IMPORTANT]
====
The `local.path` in the persistent volume spec must match the `hostPath` configured for the agent DaemonSet.
A mismatch causes duplicate download jobs to be created.
====

.Verification

. Verify that the agent DaemonSet is created and pods are scheduled to the target nodes:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get daemonset -n {dbd-config-default-namespace} -l localmodel.kserve.io/nodegroup=<node_group_name>
----
+
The output shows the DaemonSet with the expected number of required and ready pods matching the number of target nodes.

. Verify that `LocalModelNode` resources are created for each target node:
+
[source,terminal]
----
$ oc get localmodelnodes
----
+
The output lists one `LocalModelNode` resource for each node in the node group.
